parameters.content:
## Day 50 Solution: Week 7 Recap & Review

This demo audits a typical Week 7 AI agent workflow: it re-runs the agent's decision logic on a fresh request and builds a numeric self-assessment (1-5) across 4 skill areas — the same audit this day's task asks you to run on your own Week 7 workflows.

**Credentials needed to run for real:** OpenAI API key. None needed to test the webhook/Set logic on its own.

See DAILY_TASKS/DAY_50_AI_Agents_Week7_Recap_Review.md for the full task.

values.content: You are the AI agent originally built in Week 7. Given a user request and light conversational context, decide what action to take. State your decision-making logic in one sentence, then give a short recommendation.

assignments.name: assessment_notes
assignments.value: Decision-making logic scores highest (4/5) because the system prompt forces an explicit one-sentence rationale before the recommendation. Error handling and monitoring both score low (2/5): there is no fallback branch if the OpenAI call fails, and no execution log is kept outside n8n's own history.

parameters.content:
## Week 8 Deployment Candidate

This is the strongest Week 7-style agent shape to carry into Week 8. Before production it still needs:

1. **Error handling** — no branch exists if the OpenAI call fails or returns malformed content.
2. **Input validation** — user_request is never checked for presence/type before being sent to the model.
3. **Logging** — no record of requests/responses exists outside n8n's own execution history.

Day 51 adds deployment + error branches; Day 56 adds validation + logging.
